_meta.description: Known centralised-exchange deposit/hot wallets on Ethereum mainnet. A match against one of these is what lets Exchequer say 'the funds were cashed out here'.
_meta.provenance: Addresses originate from Etherscan's own public address labels (etherscan.io/accounts/label/*). The initial set was transcribed by hand; the remainder was imported from brianleect/etherscan-labels @ 923aba72c7e2d0682f7ae6194b6140bd90668dc9, a published scrape of those same pages, via backend/scripts/import_exchange_labels.py.
_meta.verification_note: Every address was checked against live mainnet data before being added: each has a real history of value-bearing transfers, consistent with exchange operation. That confirms the address is real and economically active -- it does NOT independently re-confirm which company operates it, and no free API exposes Etherscan's label data. Re-verify on etherscan.io before any evidentiary use. Candidates whose entire history was zero-value address-poisoning spam were rejected.
_meta.schema: labels maps a lowercase address to either a plain exchange name or an object {exchange, label, type}
_meta.regenerate_with: cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m scripts.import_exchange_labels && then cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m scripts.import_eth_labels --chain ethereum
_meta.contract_audit: Every address was checked for contract bytecode. Token contracts, DEX routers and bridges were removed -- funds reaching those have not been cashed out at an exchange. Exchange-operated contract wallets (multisig, deposit forwarders) were kept and typed 'contract_wallet'. Re-run with backend/scripts/audit_label_contracts.py.
_meta.supplemented_from: 683 further labels imported from dawsbot/eth-labels @ 14247ba8cf4686b747938248bee34c66089fa9d9, a newer published scrape of the same explorer label pages, and verified on chain the same way, by backend/scripts/import_eth_labels.py.

deposit_addresses.Bitget: 19027 per-customer deposit addresses, tagged 'Bitget Dep' by Etherscan, imported from dawsbot/eth-labels @ 14247ba8cf4686b747938248bee34c66089fa9d9 and each confirmed to have at least one transaction or token transfer on chain; 0 never-used addresses left out. Regenerate: cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m scripts.import_eth_labels --deposits Bitget
deposit_addresses.Binance: 4991 per-customer deposit addresses, tagged 'Binance Dep' by Etherscan, imported from dawsbot/eth-labels @ 14247ba8cf4686b747938248bee34c66089fa9d9 and each confirmed to have at least one transaction or token transfer on chain; 21 never-used addresses left out. Regenerate: cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m scripts.import_eth_labels --deposits Binance

_meta.audit_2026_11_05: 5 Nov 2026 security audit: removed labels that name a router, a DEX, another company's treasury or a contract deployer rather than a cash-out wallet (an exchange match ends a trace). OKX DEX Router 2 and 4 moved to router_labels.json.

deposits_retyped.rule: deposit_wallet only when the label says so ('X Dep: 0x..', 'X: Deposit Address'); an exchange's Deposit Funder or Eth2 Depositor, or another firm's account at it, is not one customer's deposit address
